newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close at record high as Dow gains.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close at record high as Dow gains.

text.p: UK stocks rose to a record closing high on Thursday as a clutch of results from leading UK companies beat expectations and the Dow made a firm start.
The FTSE 100 index closed 27.0 points higher at 3,932.6, surpassing its previous peak of 3,918.7 set August 28.

Gains in British Aerospace, Legal & General and RTZ helped propel the advance after well-received results and BTR rose on long-awaited restructuring news. Broadly in-line inflation data in the UK and U.S. also helped buoy bonds and equities yet share volume remained low and some said the UK market may struggle to make further headway.
